verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੁ ਉਚਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਲਖ ਭਰਿਆ ਕਾਲੇ ਵਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sir uchaa abhimaan vich kaalakh bhariaa kaale vaalaa|

en.bdb: Proud head remains erect and high yet it is coveved by the blackness of hair.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਰਵਟੇ ਕਾਲਖ ਭਰੇ ਪਿਪਣੀਆਂ ਕਾਲਖ ਸੂਰਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: bharavaTe kaalakh bhare pipaneeaa(n) kaalakh sooraalaa|

en.bdb: Eyebrows are full of blackness and the eye lashes are also like black thorns.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਇਣ ਕਾਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਦਾੜੀ ਮੁਛਾ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: loin kaale jaaneean dhaaRee muchhaa kar muh kaalaa|

en.bdb: Eyes are black (in India) and like wise beards and moustaches are also black.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਕ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਕ ਵਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਲੂੰਇ ਲੂੰਇ ਕਾਲਖ ਬੇਤਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: nak a(n)dhar nak vaal bahu loo(n)i loo(n)i kaalakh betaalaa|

en.bdb: Many trichomes are there in the nose and all of them are black.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਚੈ ਅੰਗ ਨ ਪੂਜੀਅਨਿ ਚਰਣ ਧੂੜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: auchai a(n)g na poojeean charan dhooR gurmukh dharamasaalaa|

en.bdb: Organs placed higher are not worshipped and the dust of the feet of gurmukhs  is adorable like holy places .

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰਾ ਨਖ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਚਾਇਨਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਦੁਰਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: pairaa nakh mukh ujale bhaar uchain dheh dhuraalaa|

en.bdb: Feet and nails are blessed because they carry`the load of the whole body.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰ ਧੋਵਣੁ ਅਪਵਿੱਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਜਗ ਭਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sir dhovan apavi'tr hai gurmukh charanodhak jag bhaalaa|

en.bdb: The head wash is considered dirty but the feet wash of the gurmukhs is sought after by the whole world.
Attaining the pleasure fruit the gurmukhs in their equipoise, remain as the store house of all delights.
